summary.tldr: Extends the temporary federal fuel excise tax suspension to January 31, 2027, then lowers fuel excise tax rates to half until March 31, 2027.
what_it_does: Extends the temporary suspension of the federal fuel excise tax until January 31, 2027.
Sets the excise tax rates on fuels at 50% of the regular rates from February 1, 2027 to March 31, 2027.
summary.background: The bill amends the Excise Tax Act.
